# `scikitplot.cleanprompt`

<!-- Generated by `python tools/maint_tools/generate_usage_skills.py sync` from the installed package; edit the module's docstrings or `__all__`, not this file. -->

Redact sensitive values from a prompt, then restore them from the reply.

## Install

```sh
pip install scikit-plots
pip install scikit-plots-cleanprompt  # this part only
```

## Before writing code

The API below was read from one version of the package. Check the version the
project has, and read a name's docstring and signature before calling it:

```sh
python -c "import scikitplot; print(scikitplot.__version__)"
python -c "import scikitplot.cleanprompt as m, inspect; print(inspect.signature(m.<name>)); help(m.<name>)"
```

## Example (from the docstring of `scikitplot.cleanprompt.Session`)

```pycon
>>> with session() as chat:
...     first = chat.encode("Mail ada@example.com")
...     second = chat.encode("Ping ada@example.com again")
>>> first, second
('Mail [EMAIL-1]', 'Ping [EMAIL-1] again')
```
